name: ps_RenderVolume
description: Volume PS (RenderVolume_DoVolume_*): bit0 = SAMPLEMODE (internal MSAA; only affects PASSMODE_FINAL: Texture2DMS scene depth), bits1-2 = LIGHTMODE (0 directional, 1 spotlight, 2 omni), bits3-4 = PASSMODE (0 geometry, 1 sky (ray length g_fZFar), 2 final (ray ends at scene depth)), bits5-6 = ATTENUATIONMODE (0 none, 1 polynomial, 2 inverse polynomial; only used by spotlight FALLOFFMODE_CUSTOM, else baked into the light LUTs), bits7-8 = FALLOFFMODE (Spotlight.eFalloffMode: 0 none -> LUT_P, 1 fixed -> LUT_P/S1/S2, 2 custom -> 9-sample Simpson integration with pow falloff). All 162 combinations are compiled; only 28 distinct blobs result.
